messages:
elaine (Sales): FYI customer Finex just uploaded a 120-question SIG/CAIQ, asking for completed answers by EOD Fri to keep the POC procurement on schedule. Link: https://box.com/finex/sig-2026-03.pdf

ravi (AE): Ugh, thanks. Contract at risk if we don't hit that. Can we do a prioritized ship of high-risk items first?

matt (SecOps): I can own the infrastructure/security Qs. Need GRC help for controls mapping and legal for any redactions. @nora can you take controls mapping? ETA: 48h for a draft from my side.

nora (GRC): I can do the controls mapping. Quick question — Finex flagged EU-only hosting on Q12, is that confirmed? That changes some answers.

elaine (Sales): Confirmed, Finex requires EU-only processing for customer data. Also they asked for SOC2 + pen test evidence.

matt (SecOps): We have SOC2 report link and a redacted pentest summary we can share. I'll attach both to the draft.

security-bot: Created checklist ticket REDWOOD-SEC-4829 for Finex SIG intake and assigned initial owner: matt (SecOps).

ravi (AE): For BYOK / KMS questions — can we provide a standard answer or is it deployment-specific? Customer expects details on HSM support.

nora (GRC): BYOK / customer-managed keys are supported in Private deployments only. We should flag network and KMS requirements in the answer. I'll draft the language.

matt (SecOps): Draft uploaded to the team folder: https://redwood.atlassian/attachments/finex-sig-draft.docx — please review sections 2/3 for infra bits. Flag anything you want phrased more cautiously.

elaine (Sales): Quick ask — who will be the single owner we can point the customer to for follow-ups and the Friday demo? Ravi will coordinate demo logistics but need the single questionnaire owner.

matt (SecOps): I'll be the owner for the questionnaire responses. Ravi will handle demo scheduling and customer comms. Nora will own controls mapping and legal outreach.

ravi (AE): Sounds good. Elaine, I'll tell Finex we have an internal owner and will deliver draft by Thu EOD.

nora (GRC): I'll mark items that need legal redaction and set due date in the tracker. Adding deadline: 2026-03-14 17:00 UTC.

elaine (Sales): Perfect. Ping me when draft is ready and I'll escalate if they push the vendor deadline earlier. :thumbsup:

matt (SecOps): Draft has most answers; two items left that require product confirmation (Q71, Q104). @product-team — please take a look if you get pinged.

ravi (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll update Finex and close the loop once legal signs off.

security-bot: Ticket REDWOOD-SEC-4829 updated: status -> in_progress; owners -> matt, nora.
